lens: Member evaluator — narrow mobile viewport (simulated user lens)
reason: The public mobile capture is legible and coherent with Precision Instrument: a clear consulting proposition, two useful actions and restrained engineering detail. Source honestly marks case studies pending approval and discloses original-resume access. I traced My work → calibrated assignment → rating/evidence → review → receipt-gated lock in source; native radios, explicit not-observed handling and readiness checks support that journey. However, the separate Group Case entry flow blocks observation-only saving and does not tell members whether saved evidence is valid. These gaps prevent unqualified acceptance for this evaluator task. This is an independent AI source/artifact assessment, not observed user success or a live authenticated mobile session.

findings.evidence: editNote returns with “Pick a star to save” whenever every score is null; flushNote also requires a scored criterion. There is no note backup here. Conversely, rate_group_case_applicant in supabase/migrations/20261016191000_grading_contract_consistency.sql:267-279 permits a zero-score save when clean_note is present.
findings.userImpact: A member who records an observation before confidently assigning a score cannot persist it. Leaving or refreshing loses that note, and the prompt encourages premature scoring of uncertain evidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Save nonblank notes with null scores using the existing RPC contract; retain unsaved notes on failure and show an explicit observation-only receipt.

findings.evidence: The member row reports only “N of M rated” and Saved (333-337). GroupCaseRoster has no minimum-observed or validity field in src/lib/group-case-roster.ts. Database quality separately requires 75% weighted coverage, rubric minimum and required criteria (20261016191000_grading_contract_consistency.sql:5-33); Board results explain these prerequisites in src/lib/group-case-results.ts:evaluationPrerequisites.
findings.userImpact: A narrow-screen evaluator can verify persistence but cannot distinguish their partial observations from valid completion or identify exactly what remains needed. Equal rated counts can represent different weighted/required coverage.
findings.suggestedFix: Return authoritative per-reviewer validity and blockers with the roster/save receipt; display “Saved partial observations” versus “Valid evaluation saved,” weighted coverage and missing required criteria without pressuring members to invent observations.

notVerified: No evaluator capture or authenticated mobile interaction was supplied; layout with the software keyboard, long notes/names, focus movement and task completion remains unobserved.
No staging or hosted Clerk/Supabase/RLS/storage/email integration, deployment or migration rollout was tested. Supplied local logs and synthetic browser fixtures do not establish these.

No human usability study, physical-device/Safari/Firefox or assistive-technology validation exists. Public client outcomes/artifacts await approval; Board resolution of original-resume/blind-review policy remains external.
